verdict.rationale: Vanta documents its own policy-authoring capability: an agentic policy generator and an AI agent that drafts policies. Policies are also first-class objects that can be listed and uploaded via the API. The rest of the story is unevidenced; the 'submit for review' citation concerns evidence files attached to documents, not policy approvals. Missing for 10: a lawyer-grade policy template library, an in-app policy editor, policy versioning, policy approval workflows, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking

citations.quote: One compliance framework with agentic policy generator
working tirelessly across the Vanta platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues before they escalate
use it to list documents, policies, and evidence in your Vanta tenant, filtered by compliance framework
